title: Our School — A Happy Place
lesson: To understand ‘Our School — A Happy Place’, begin with the situation presented in the chapter and identify what is happening. Focus on safe and inclusive school spaces and plants and animals around school, then look for evidence for roles in a school community. Finally, explain what you learned and how the idea can guide a decision or observation outside the chapter.
